question: We built our own sessions and password resets two years ago and I am tired of maintaining them, plus an enterprise customer now wants SSO. Node backend, React front end, a few thousand users to migrate. Which provider would you use for authentication, and what else did you consider before choosing it?
summary: Test a migrated login and an enterprise SSO connection. The recorded mentions do not show whether an agent can complete these tasks.

items.title: Test the documented integration
items.finding: Kinde already documents a Management API and migration paths. The scan missed a conventional entry file and machine-readable spec; it did not show that the SDK route is unusable. Dashboard registration metadata and application-user provisioning are distinct. A JavaScript signup form does not prove an integration block.
items.nextStep: Import synthetic legacy users with a supported hash and mapped IDs, then verify sign-in through the supported hosted flow. Connect a test enterprise identity provider and verify the returning account maps to the intended organization without creating an unintended duplicate identity.
items.validation: Keep import output, identity mapping, accepted and rejected logins and explicit account handoffs. Do not substitute a password grant for the documented redirect flow.
